Services
Two things, done properly.
After a decade of enterprise software, we now work for the businesses that keep the Gulf Coast running.
The same person designs it, builds it, and answers when you call, whichever of the two you need.
Custom software
Every business runs on a few things that never made it into any official system: the client list split across three phones, the schedule you're building from a paper calendar and a gut feeling, the order that gets tracked in a group text until someone loses it.
We build the small, sturdy tool that replaces whichever one is costing you the most time. Then we can stay on to keep it running and add to it as the business grows.
Web design
Most customers see your website before they see you. They're choosing where to eat tonight, booking a charter, or comparing venues, and the site is what they go on.
Ours load fast and read clearly on a phone. Each is built around what the visitor should do next: call, book, order, or walk in.
You can update the menu yourself in a few minutes, with no PDF to re-upload. Bookings come to you instead of going through a third-party app. Every site is designed and constructed by hand for the business it belongs to.
How a project runs
Discovery
We start with a conversation and skip the questionnaire and the slide-deck workshop. Afterwards you get a scope in plain English, short enough to read in one sitting.
Build
You get a working link at the start of the project. It opens the real build, so you can click through it as it takes shape and send feedback as you go. Nothing waits for a big reveal at the end.
Launch
We test it on phones, tablets, and desktops, then hand it over with an owner's manual and a bow. Stay with us afterwards, or take it anywhere you like.
Care
Software needs upkeep like anything else. We offer ongoing care that keeps yours secure and up to date as the business changes. It's yours either way.
Every project starts with a normal conversation.
